views.name: race_with_circuit
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.year AS year,
  races.round AS round,
  races.circuitId AS circuitId,
  races.name AS name,
  races.date AS date,
  races.time AS time,
  races.url AS url,
  circuits.circuitRef AS circuitRef,
  circuits.name AS name, -- circuit name (note: same column name as races.name preserved as 'name' per rule; consumer can disambiguate by joining back if needed)
  circuits.location AS location,
  circuits.country AS country,
  circuits.lat AS lat,
  circuits.lng AS lng,
  circuits.alt AS alt,
  circuits.url AS url
FROM races
LEFT JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
views.description: Denormalized view of races enriched with circuit attributes. Useful when answering questions about races with circuit location, country or coordinates. | Use for: List races with circuit country or coordinates; Filter races by circuit country or location; Map races to circuit attributes

views.name: driver_profile
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  driverId AS driverId,
  driverRef AS driverRef,
  number AS number,
  code AS code,
  forename AS forename,
  surname AS surname,
  dob AS dob,
  nationality AS nationality,
  url AS url
FROM drivers
views.description: Canonical driver table exposing identifying and demographic attributes for reuse in joins and reporting. | Use for: Driver lookups by id or name; Age calculations when joined to a race date; Filtering drivers by nationality or code

views.name: race_results_enriched
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  results.resultId AS resultId,
  results.raceId AS raceId,
  results.driverId AS driverId,
  results.constructorId AS constructorId,
  results.number AS number,
  results.grid AS grid,
  results.position AS position,
  results.positionText AS positionText,
  results.positionOrder AS positionOrder,
  results.points AS points,
  results.laps AS laps,
  results.time AS time,
  results.milliseconds AS milliseconds,
  results.fastestLap AS fastestLap,
  results.rank AS rank,
  results.fastestLapTime AS fastestLapTime,
  results.fastestLapSpeed AS fastestLapSpeed,
  results.statusId AS statusId,
  drivers.driverRef AS driverRef,
  drivers.forename AS forename,
  drivers.surname AS surname,
  drivers.code AS code,
  constructors.constructorRef AS constructorRef,
  constructors.name AS name,
  races.year AS year,
  races.round AS round,
  races.date AS date,
  races.time AS time,
  status.status AS status
FROM results
LEFT JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
LEFT JOIN constructors ON results.constructorId = constructors.constructorId
LEFT JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
LEFT JOIN status ON results.statusId = status.statusId
views.description: Results rows enriched with driver, constructor, race and status attributes. Useful as a base for most analytics about finishing positions, points, and fastest laps. | Use for: Who finished where in a given race or season; Aggregate points by driver/constructor; Filter results by status (Finished/Disqualified); Find fastest lap holders or fastestLapTime analysis

views.name: lap_time_summary_by_driver_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  lapTimes.raceId AS raceId,
  lapTimes.driverId AS driverId,
  COUNT(lapTimes.lap) AS lap_count,
  MIN(lapTimes.milliseconds) AS min_milliseconds,
  AVG(lapTimes.milliseconds) AS avg_milliseconds,
  MAX(lapTimes.milliseconds) AS max_milliseconds
FROM lapTimes
GROUP BY lapTimes.raceId, lapTimes.driverId
views.description: Aggregated lap-time measures per driver per race: count of laps, min/median/max milliseconds and average. Useful for comparing consistency and pace across drivers or races. | Use for: Compare average lap time per driver in a race; Filter drivers by number of laps recorded in a race; Find best lap times per driver per race

views.name: driver_career_points
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  results.driverId AS driverId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT results.raceId) AS races_competed,
  SUM(results.points) AS total_points,
  AVG(results.points) AS avg_points_per_race
FROM results
GROUP BY results.driverId
views.description: Total points and race counts aggregated per driver across all seasons. Useful for career summaries and leaderboard computations. | Use for: Who are the top scoring drivers overall; Average points per race for a driver; Compare career totals between drivers

views.name: qualifying_best_position_per_driver_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  q.raceId AS raceId,
  q.driverId AS driverId,
  MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying_position
FROM qualifying q
GROUP BY q.raceId, q.driverId
views.description: Per driver per race the best qualifying position (lowest numeric position). Exposes a best_position rank to support Top-K or filtering by best qual performance. | Use for: Find who qualified on pole in a race (when joined to race and filtered for best_qualifying_position=1); Compare qualifying performance vs race result; Top qualifying performers across seasons when aggregated

views.name: pitstop_summary_per_driver_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pitStops.raceId AS raceId,
  pitStops.driverId AS driverId,
  COUNT(pitStops.stop) AS pit_stop_count,
  SUM(pitStops.milliseconds) AS total_pit_milliseconds,
  AVG(pitStops.milliseconds) AS avg_pit_milliseconds
FROM pitStops
GROUP BY pitStops.raceId, pitStops.driverId
views.description: Aggregated pit stop measures per driver per race: count of stops and total/avg milliseconds. Useful for pit strategy analysis. | Use for: Compare pit stop counts between drivers in a race; Analyze pit stop time impact on race results; Filter races by drivers with high number of pit stops

views.name: race_podiums
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  results.*
FROM results
WHERE results.position IN (1,2,3)
views.description: Subset of results limited to podium finishes (positions 1-3) expressed as a reusable cohort. Useful wherever podiums are needed. | Use for: List podium finishers by race or season; Count podiums per driver or constructor; Analyze podium frequency

views.name: season_race_calendar
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.year AS year,
  races.round AS round,
  races.name AS name,
  races.date AS date,
  races.time AS time,
  races.circuitId AS circuitId
FROM races
views.description: One-row per race with season context sorted by date; exposes ordering (round) and date for temporal analyses across a season. | Use for: List races in a season calendar order; Join calendar to results or standings for season-level analysis; Filter races by date range or round
